_metadata.backup_type: Declarative restoration record; HERO12/Quik does not export a Panasonic-style binary settings file
_metadata.phone_app: GoPro Quik 13.38-era interface with camera-mode management introduced in 13.28

mounts: Premium suction mount for rental-car hood
PGYTECH backpack-strap quick-release clip with articulating adapter

privacy_and_sync.control_phone: Owner's phone; operated only by the passenger while the car is moving
privacy_and_sync.clock_rule: In Quik, use Set Date and Time at the start of each shooting day and after every time-zone change; phone automatic date/time/time-zone must be enabled

timewarp_road_2x.use: Road highlights; record 20-30 seconds for 10-15 seconds of output

video_road_trail.use: Real-time road and backpack-strap trail video

video_snorkel_temporary.use: Handheld with floating grip; restore 30 fps and L+ after leaving the water

restoration_order: Factory-reset and pair the HERO12 with GoPro Quik only if restoration is actually required
On the camera, enable Pro Controls
Recreate each mode from the values in this file
Use Set Date and Time in Quik
Confirm firmware 2.40 or the then-current approved firmware
